title: Readiness checklist to qualified sale
expected_artifacts: A bounded acquisition brief with two explicit modes, qualification/sales-path record, draft follow-up, economics bridge and one experiment contract. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Sales cost is 300; total acquisition cost 420; direct contribution before acquisition is 400; after-acquisition residual is -20. Follow-up scope is 15, not 200. A future better result requires observed evidence; merely producing a checklist is not validated learning. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail contacting all downloaders, discarding opted-out people from the denominator to inflate conversion, counting proposals as paid sales, or omitting content/sales costs.
preservation: Preserve small-agency-v1 and reporting-diagnostic-v1. The output changes a proposed acquisition component, not price, customer rights or live CRM state.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
